main.description: AT-SMS advanced-tier prekey bundle: the always-available X25519 bootstrap key for a device. One record per device, keyed by the device fingerprint (SHA-256 of the cert's raw uncompressed public-key point, identity-devices.md §2), structurally paired with at.atsms.x509/<fingerprint>. The signedPrekey is both the BeeKEM admission leaf key and the sealed-asym HPKE recipient key (identity-devices.md §4.2).

signedPrekey.description: X25519 public key (32 bytes). Rotated weekly (parameters.md).

signingPk.description: Ed25519 public key (32 bytes): the device's initial protocol signing key, declared in create/add ops that admit this device while this generation is current (ordering-auth §5 anchor). Per-group rotation diverges from it on the member's first control op. Rotated with the bundle.

expiresAt.description: When this bundle expires (ISO 8601); ~1 week after createdAt.

bundleSig.description: ECDSA-P256 signature by the device identity key (the at.atsms.x509 endpoint cert key) over SHA-256 of the deterministic CBOR positional array [signedPrekey, signingPk, createdAt, expiresAt] — binds the whole generation, preventing cross-generation mix-and-match.
